system.description: When you would take damage from a creature within range of one of your unarmed/weapon attacks or a Jutsu you know, you can spend two superiority die and your reaction. Make an attack or cast a Jutsu targeting the triggering creature. If you score a hit or the affected creature fails their saving throw, you can attack again or cast the same jutsu again, targeting the same creature. If you are making an attack, you do so with a -4 penalty to hit. If they are making a save, they do so with a +4 bonus to their save, repeating the effects of this maneuver on a successful hit or failed save. Each time beyond the first that you repeat this casting or attack, the penalty/bonus increases by -/+ 2 respectively.

roll.note: Attack or cast at the triggering creature; repeat on a hit or failed save (−4 to hit / +4 to its save, growing by 2).
